[NRTM.5.4] An integrator targeting a server-class deployment that wants the
bounded-memory cap without the embedded LIVE protocol loads a program carrying a
realtime contract, sets `N_max` with `ds_engine_set_wm_max`, and pumps normally,
without calling `ds_engine_go_live`; the LIVE-phase protocol is an embedded
concern. Without a contract the setter caps nothing ([NRTM.3.1]).
